description.la: Hugonis opuscula minora: de laude charitatis, de amore sponsi ad sponsam, de modo orandi, de quinque septenis, de artificio meditandi, de voluntate Dei, de sapientia animae Christi, de virginitate Mariae, Magnificat, Decalogus, epistolae.
description.en-US: Hugh’s shorter works in one book: In Praise of Charity, On the Bridegroom’s Love for the Bride, On the Way of Praying, On the Five Sevens, On the Art of Meditating, on the will and wisdom of Christ, On the Virginity of Mary, the commentary on the Magnificat, On the Fruits of the Flesh and of the Spirit (PL, of doubtful authorship), the Commandments and the letters. Latin only, from the Migne text (Patrologia Latina 176, 1854), a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: Os opúsculos menores de Hugo num só livro: louvor da caridade, o amor do esposo pela esposa, o modo de rezar, os cinco setenários, a arte de meditar, a vontade e a sabedoria de Cristo, a virgindade de Maria, o Magnificat, os mandamentos e as cartas.
